# TechScript

> TechScript is a general-purpose, human-first programming language with zero syntax clutter. Write code with natural keywords: `say`, `do`, `when`, `for`, `send`, `try`, `catch`. Powered by a high-performance stack VM written in Rust and an LLVM native backend.

## Key Links

- [Official Website](https://techscript.is-a.dev/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript)
- [Latest Releases & Download](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/releases/latest)
- [Documentation Portal](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/tree/main/docs)
- [Language Guide](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/blob/main/docs/LanguageGuide.md)
- [Syntax Guide](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/blob/main/docs/SyntaxGuide.md)
- [Projects Showcase](https://techscript.is-a.dev/projects.html)

## Language Philosophy
- **Natural Language Readability**: Keywords form spoken English structures (e.g. `say "hello"`, `x = 10`, `when x > 5`, `do greet(name)` ... `send "Hi "` ... `end`).
- **Zero Syntax Clutter**: Eliminates curly braces, semicolons, and bracket overhead.
- **High Performance Stack VM**: Compiles to bytecode and executes on a memory-safe, fast stack VM written in Rust with NaN-boxed values and tracing GC.
- **Native LLVM Backend**: Generates standalone native machine code executables.
- **Unified Toolchain Driver**: Single driver executable `tsc` handles `run`, `build`, `check`, `fmt`, `lint`, `test`, `repl`, `publish`, and `dump-ast`.

## Unified `tsc` CLI Toolchain
- `tsc run <file.txs>`: Compiles and executes a single `.txs` script.
- `tsc build`: Builds the workspace project matching `package.toml`.
- `tsc check`: Checks workspace for compile-time errors.
- `tsc fmt`: Standardizes codebase formatting with `tsfmt`.
- `tsc lint`: Evaluates safety traps and lints codebase.
- `tsc test`: Executes unit tests.
- `tsc repl`: Launches interactive REPL shell.

## Syntax Quick Reference

### Print to screen
```techscript
say "Hello, World!"
```

### Variables & Constants
```techscript
x = 10
const PI = 3.14159
```

### Conditionals
```techscript
when age >= 18
  say "Adult"
else
  when age >= 13
    say "Teenager"
  else
    say "Child"
  end
end
```

### Loops
```techscript
for item in list
  say item
end

for i in 0..5
  say i
end
```

### Functions
```techscript
do greet(name)
  send "Hello, " + name
end
```

### Error Handling
```techscript
try
  res = divide(10, 0)
catch err
  say err
end
```
